summary_en: 365,834 shares tendered (0.8% S/O). Tender offer concluded 2026-08-03, settlement starts 2026-08-10. Nice Inc. acquires parallel holdings from limited company Estate Yamadai and K.K. Yamayuu Shokurin under pre-signed agreement. Combined acquisitions give Nice >50% voting stake; becomes new parent and largest shareholder.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Tender Offer for Company Shares by Nice Inc. and Notice of Changes in Parent Company and Principal Shareholder
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-03, the public tender offer for Yamadai Corporation shares by Nice Inc. concluded successfully. A total of 365,834 shares were tendered, exceeding the minimum threshold of 261,700 shares, making the offer valid. All tendered shares were acquired by Nice Inc. Additionally, pursuant to an agreement signed 2026-06-01, Nice Inc. simultaneously acquired all shares held by two major shareholders—limited company Estate Yamadai and K.K. Yamayuu Shokurin—through a parallel purchase arrangement. Settlement of both the tender offer and parallel purchases commences 2026-08-10, at which point Nice Inc.'s aggregate voting stake exceeds 50%, establishing it as the new parent company and principal shareholder. The acquisition follows a business alliance agreement signed 2026-01-09 between Yamadai and Nice, focused on outsourcing of standard precut timber processing and strengthening of domestic timber supply.
